metadata.title: One Electron Interferes With Itself
metadata.thing: the single-electron buildup: dots becoming fringes
metadata.long_title: One Electron Interferes With Itself — in about a minute | Bear's Notes
metadata.description_blurb: The single-electron double slit in about a minute: dots land one at a time, random at first — then 70,000 dots later, interference stripes. Each electron's wave goes through both slits and interferes with itself; the dot histogram is |ψ|²; and watching which slit kills the fringes. Full explainer (the buildup, de Broglie's λ = h/p, the forbidden bands) on the channel.
metadata.short_blurb: The single-electron double slit, in about a minute. Full explainer on the channel.

beats.video_animation_prompt: Fade in series line, Write the title, brown underline, blue tick. Hold.

beats.narration_text: Fire electrons at two slits one at a time — each arrives as a single dot.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Fire electrons at two slits one at a time — each arrives as a single dot.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] The apparatus: gun (left), barrier with two slits (center), screen (right); a blue electron flies across and lands as an ink microdot; another follows.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create apparatus; two electrons fly and land as microdots.

beats.narration_text: Ten in, the dots look random; common sense says two heaps, one behind each slit.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Ten in, the dots look random; common sense says two heaps, one behind each slit.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Eight more scattered microdots; a dashed secondary two-heap curve appears at the screen; mono counter 'electrons: 10' bottom-left.
beats.video_animation_prompt: LaggedStart dots; Create dashed heaps; FadeIn counter.

beats.narration_text: Seventy thousand in: stripes — bright and dark bands no two-heap picture allows.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Seventy thousand in: stripes — bright and dark bands no two-heap picture allows.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] A rapid lagged rain completes clear fringe bands of dots; counter to 'electrons: 70,000'; the dashed heaps dim.
beats.video_animation_prompt: LaggedStart the full fringe batch; counter morph; heaps to low opacity.

beats.narration_text: Stripes are what waves do: ripples through both slits overlap and cancel.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Stripes are what waves do: ripples through both slits overlap and cancel.
accumulated_scene_state: blue arc fans from both slits
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] Blue arc fans bloom from both slits; a blue striped intensity curve draws along the screen, matching the dot bands.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create both arc fans; Create striped curve over the dots.

beats.narration_text: Particles can't do that — a ball takes one slit and joins its heap.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Particles can't do that — a ball takes one slit and joins its heap.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] A brown ball flies through a single slit to the screen; the dashed two-heap curve pulses once.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Brown ball flight; heaps curve opacity up, Indicate, back down.

beats.narration_text: And these electrons flew alone: never a second one in the machine to interfere with.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And these electrons flew alone: never a second one in the machine to interfere with.
accumulated_scene_state: label: one at a time, near gun
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] Small ink label 'one at a time' by the gun; the gun pulses.

beats.narration_text: So each electron's wave goes through both slits and interferes with itself.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So each electron's wave goes through both slits and interferes with itself.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] Both arc fans brighten together — one electron's wave in both slits at once — then settle faint.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Fans to higher opacity together; hold; settle to faint.

beats.narration_text: The dot is where it's found; the stripes map where finding it is likely — psi squared.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The dot is where it's found; the stripes map where finding it is likely — psi squared.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] MathTex |ψ|² writes in the top strip — the name as endpoint.

beats.narration_text: Peek at which slit it took, and the stripes vanish — information kills them.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Peek at which slit it took, and the stripes vanish — information kills them.
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] A small secondary detector glyph appears at the upper slit; the blue striped curve morphs into brown two heaps; the dot bands dim.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn eye glyph; Transform stripes→heaps; dots to 30%.

beats.narration_text: Molecules of two thousand atoms paint the same stripes; your wavelength is just too small to show it.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Molecules of two thousand atoms paint the same stripes; your wavelength is just too small to show it.
beats.new_visual_element: [BOUNDARY] The top strip content fades; a line writes: '2,000-atom molecules: stripes · you: λ ≈ 10⁻³⁵ m'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeOut |ψ|²; write the scale line fitted to the top strip.
